title: 第517章 一切都是为地府服务第516章 上清门人齐聚
content_zh:
礼物送完，林道然身形一闪，化作一道金光，从南天门直直坠向凡间。
然而，天上一日，地下一年。
虽然只在南天门只待了半个多时辰，但是人间，已经过了大半个月了。
等他回到苏杭城，时间已经来到了五月初五，端午节。
苏杭城，上清观。
夜已深，月华如水，洒落在青石板铺就的院子里，镀上一层淡淡的银辉。
院子中央，摆着一张破旧的木桌。
桌上，烧鸡、卤肉、粽子、雄黄酒，堆得满满当当。
燕赤霞和知秋一叶，正对着月亮，大口吃肉，大口喝酒！
“来！干！”
燕赤霞举起酒碗，一饮而尽，酒液顺着他的胡须流淌而下，浸湿了胸前的衣襟。
“老头，你少喝点！”
知秋一叶嘴里塞满了鸡肉，含糊不清地说道。
“不然等观主回来，看到你这副醉醺醺的模样，又要骂你喝酒不叫他了！”
“怕什么？”
燕赤霞打了个酒嗝，满脸通红，眼中带着几分醉意。
“观主神出鬼没的，谁知道他什么时候回来？难道他没回来，老夫还不能喝酒了？”
就在这时，林道然的身影，悄无声息地出现在院墙上。
他双手抱胸，居高临下地看着院子里那两个“堕落”的家伙，嘴角微微抽搐。
喝酒不叫观主？

还懂不懂职场生存法则了？
而且，你们修为这么低，一个地仙，一个天师中期，怎么还有心情喝酒吃肉的？
你们不应该好好学习一下，你们观主我，每天努力修炼二十四小时？
内心谴责归谴责，酒还是要喝的！
“嗖~”
林道然身形一闪，如鬼魅般出现在两人身旁！
“啪~”
一只手夺过知秋一叶刚拿到手的烧鸡！
“咕噜~”
另一只手拿起桌子上的酒坛，仰头便灌！
“观......观主？”
知秋一叶一愣，看着空荡荡的手，又看了看正在狼吞虎咽的林道然，嘴角微微抽搐。
“您......您回来了？”
燕赤霞也是一愣，随即打了个酒嗝，满脸通红地笑道：
“观主，来......来一起喝！”
content_en:
After the gift was delivered, Lin Daoran's figure flashed and turned into a golden light, falling straight from the Nantian Gate to the mortal world.
However, one day in the sky and one year in the earth.
Although I only stayed at Nantianmen for more than half an hour, more than half a month has passed in the human world.
By the time he returned to Suzhou and Hangzhou, it was already the fifth day of May, the Dragon Boat Festival.
Suzhou and Hangzhou City, Shangqing Temple.
It was late at night, and the moonlight was like water, falling on the courtyard paved with bluestone slabs, coating it with a faint silver glow.
In the center of the courtyard, there was an old wooden table.
The table was piled high with roasted chicken, braised pork, rice dumplings, and realgar wine.
Yan Chixia and Zhiqiu Yiye are facing the moon, eating meat and drinking wine!
"Come on! Do it!"
Yan Chixia raised the wine bowl and drank it all in one gulp. The wine flowed down his beard and soaked the clothes on his chest.
"Old man, drink less!"
Zhiqiu Yiye said vaguely with his mouth full of chicken.
"Otherwise, when the temple owner comes back and sees you looking drunk, he will scold you again for not calling him for drinking!"
"What are you afraid of?"
Yan Chixia burped from wine, her face flushed, and her eyes looked a little drunk.
"The temple master is so elusive. Who knows when he will come back? Could it be that I can't drink anymore if he doesn't come back?"
At this moment, Lin Daoran's figure appeared quietly on the courtyard wall.
He crossed his arms and looked down at the two "degenerate" guys in the yard, with a slight twitch in the corner of his mouth.
Don’t you call me a Guanzhu when you drink?
Do you still understand the rules of survival in the workplace?
Moreover, your cultivation level is so low, how can you, an earthly immortal and a mid-level heavenly master, still be in the mood to drink and eat meat?
Shouldn't you study hard, watch the Lord, and practice hard twenty-four hours a day?
Even if the inner condemnation is condemnation, you still have to drink wine!
"Whoosh~"
Lin Daoran's body flashed and appeared next to the two of them like a ghost!
"Pa~"
One hand snatched the roast chicken that Zhiqiu Yiye had just received!
"Gulu~"
With the other hand, he picked up the wine jar on the table, raised his head and drank!
"Guan... Guanzhu?"
Zhiqiu Yiye was stunned, looking at his empty hands, and then at Lin Daoran who was devouring the food, with the corner of his mouth twitching slightly.
"You...you're back?"
Yan Chixia was also stunned for a moment, then burped and said with a flushed smile:
"Master Guan, come... come and drink together!"
